guessing_game:
## The guessing game from the Rust book, in Cera.
##
##   cerac run examples/guessing_game.cera
##
## The computer picks a number from 1 to 100; you guess until you get it.
import std.io
import std.time
import std.bits

## A pseudo-random number in 1..=100 from a seed (a linear congruential step).
secret_from :: fn(seed: u64) -> i64 do
  mixed = bits.wrapping_add(bits.wrapping_mul(seed, 6364136223846793005), 1442695040888963407)
  roll = bits.shr(mixed, 33) % 100
  Option.unwrap_or(Num.to_i64(roll), 0) + 1
end

## Ask until the player gives a number; `None` means the input ended.
read_guess :: fn() -> Option<i64> do
  io.print("Please input your guess: ")
  match io.read_line() do
    None -> None
    Some(line) ->
      match String.parse_i64(String.trim(line)) do
        Some(n) -> Some(n)
        None -> do
          io.println("Please type a number!")
          read_guess()
        end
      end
  end
end

play :: fn(secret: i64, tries: i32) do
  match read_guess() do
    None -> io.println("Goodbye!")
    Some(guess) -> do
      io.println(String.concat(["You guessed: ", show(guess)]))
      match compare(guess, secret) do
        Less -> do
          io.println("Too small!")
          play(secret, tries + 1)
        end
        Greater -> do
          io.println("Too big!")
          play(secret, tries + 1)
        end
        Equal -> io.println(String.concat(["You win, in ", show(tries), " tries!"]))
      end
    end
  end
end

main :: fn(caps: Caps) do
  seed = Option.unwrap_or(Num.to_u64(time.now_ms(caps.clock)), 1)
  io.println("Guess the number!")
  play(secret_from(seed), 1)
end

loops:
import std.io
import std.list

sum_to :: fn(n: i64) -> i64 do
  var total = 0
  var i = 1
  while i <= n do
    total := total + i
    i := i + 1
  end
  total
end

evens :: fn(xs: [i64]) -> i64 do
  var acc = 0
  for x in xs do
    if x % 2 != 0 do
      continue
    end
    if x > 20 do
      break
    end
    acc := acc + x
  end
  acc
end

nested :: fn() -> i64 do
  var count = 0
  for a in list.range(0, 5) do
    var b = 0
    while true do
      b := b + 1
      if b > a do
        break
      end
      count := count + 1
    end
  end
  count
end

main :: fn() do
  io.println(sum_to(100))
  io.println(evens(list.range(0, 100)))
  io.println(nested())
  var words = ["a", "b", "c"]
  var n = 0
  for w in words do
    io.println(w)
    n := n + 1
  end
  io.println(n)
end

import std.io

Shape :: type
  | Circle(r: f64)
  | Rect(w: f64, h: f64)
end

area :: fn(s: Shape) -> f64 do
  match s do
    Circle(r)  -> 3.14159 * r * r
    Rect(w, h) -> w * h
  end
end

main :: fn() do
  region do
    shapes = [Circle(2.0), Rect(3.0, 4.0)]
    shapes
      |> map(area)
      |> sum
      |> io.println
  end
end
traits:
import std.io

Shape :: type
  | Circle(r: f64)
  | Rect(w: f64, h: f64)
end

Area :: trait
  area :: fn(self) -> f64
end

impl Area for Shape do
  area :: fn(s: Shape) -> f64 do
    match s do
      Circle(r)  -> 3.14159 * r * r
      Rect(w, h) -> w * h
    end
  end
end

impl Show for Shape do
  show :: fn(s: Shape) -> String do
    match s do
      Circle(_)  -> "circle"
      Rect(_, _) -> "rectangle"
    end
  end
end

total :: fn<T: Area>(xs: [T]) -> f64 do
  match xs do
    [] -> 0.0
    [x | rest] -> area(x) + total(rest)
  end
end

main :: fn() do
  shapes = [Circle(1.0), Rect(2.0, 3.0)]
  io.println(shapes)
  io.println(total(shapes))
end
